request.style: English, deep male baritone soul, solo voice with gospel choir, upright piano, Hammond organ, warm electric bass, soft drums, reverent and gentle mood, 72 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
From the sons of Cush, Seba is named
Havilah, Sabtah, and Raamah
The sons of Raamah, Sheba and Dedan
A line of nations, known by name
Cush fathered Nimrod, mighty on earth
A hunter before the Lord, it is said
Like Nimrod, a mighty hunter
Kingdoms of Babel, Erech, and Akkad

[Chorus]
Sons of Shem, the older brother
Father of all the sons of Eber
Elam, Asshur, Arpachshad
Lud, and Aram, by their clans

[Verse]
Arpachshad fathered Shelah
Shelah fathered Eber, the line
Two sons were born to Eber
Peleg, for the earth was divided
Joktan fathered Almodad
Sheleph, Hazarmaveth, Jerah
Hadoram, Uzal, Diklah
Obal, Abimael, and Sheba

[Chorus]
Sons of Shem, the older brother
Father of all the sons of Eber
Elam, Asshur, Arpachshad
Lud, and Aram, by their clans

[Bridge]
Jokshan fathered Sheba and Dedan
The sons of Dedan, Asshurim
Letushim, and Leummim born
Keturah bore Zimran, Jokshan
Medan, Midian, Ishbak, Shuah
The lineage spreads, the branches grow

[Outro]
Shem, Arpachshad, Shelah
Eber, Peleg, Reu, Serug
Nahor, Terah, Abram
That is Abraham, the father

[Chorus]
Sons of Shem, the older brother
Father of all the sons of Eber
Elam, Asshur, Arpachshad
Lud, and Aram, by their clans
